_meanings:
Sputtered, pronounced indistinctly in shutting the
 lips, the sound thus remaining as it were in the mouth; uttered while
 emitting saliva from the mouth.

A sputtering noise, the growling of a bear; {#daDati kuharaBAjAmatra#}
 {#BallUkayUnAmanurasitagurURi styAnambUkftAni#} <ls>U. 2. 21</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 6</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 41</ls>.
